Resource build inputs

The original i18nFlags_16x11.rc references bitmap sources restored losslessly
from the original BITMAP resources. Upstream licensing and attribution are
unchanged. The flag RC paths use forward slashes for Windows RC escape handling.

Only the custom flag resources are built by tools/Build-Resources.ps1.
Package VersionInfo RC wrappers are intentionally omitted: MSBuild owns version
and platform metadata. Compiled RES files are ignored build outputs.
